name: Åbo Akademi University
englishBachelors: None. Every bachelor's degree at Åbo Akademi is taught in Swedish and requires documented Swedish. Nine international master's degrees are taught in English.
note: Finland's Swedish-language university, and closed to you at bachelor level unless you can read and write Swedish — though if you speak Danish or Norwegian your Swedish may be closer to adequate than most applicants', so it is worth asking. Its English-taught master's degrees include international law and human rights, and peace mediation. Åbo Akademi does not mention the IB anywhere on its English bachelor pages.
summary: Swedish-language university in Turku and Vaasa; its bachelor's degrees are taught in Swedish, and English-taught study starts at master's level.

ib.text: Bachelor's applicants must document Swedish: in the IB, Swedish A at grade 2 or Swedish B at grade 5.

notes: All bachelor's degrees at Åbo Akademi are taught in Swedish, and you must document your Swedish to be admitted.
The Danish route needs Dansk A on a Danish upper-secondary degree; for the IB, only Swedish A or B counts.
